events.context: Filename naming best practices: 简洁明确, 一致性, 避免歧义, 考虑排序, 兼容性
Example bad filename: FINAL_FINAL_v2_really_final_new(1).docx and good examples: proposal-v2.3-client-review.docx, 2024-01-28-meeting-minutes.md, user-data-export.csv
Guide on correct usage of tree command
Linux Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install tree
Linux CentOS/RHEL: sudo yum install tree
macOS Homebrew: brew install tree
Windows Scoop: scoop install tree or download from gnuwin32.sourceforge.net/packages/tree.htm
Basic tree usage: tree (current directory), tree /path/to/directory (specified directory)
Tree options: -L 2 (depth limit), -a (all files), -d (directories only), -f (full path), -p (permissions), -s (size), -h (human readable size), -psh (combined)
Pattern matching: -P "*.txt" (include), -I "*.log" (exclude), tree > output.txt (output to file)
Advanced tree: -i (inode), -J (JSON), -X (XML), -H http://example.com -o output.html (HTML), -t (time sort), -r (reverse), -s -S (size sort)
Practical examples: tree -L 3 ~, tree -ad /var/log, tree -psh /etc > etc_tree.txt, tree -I "*.log|*.tmp"
Tree help: tree --help, tree --version
Git commands basic operations
Git config: git config --global user.name "name", git config --global user.email "email", git config --list
Repository: git init, git clone <URL>
Status: git status, git status -s
Add: git add <file>, git add ., git add -A
Commit: git commit -m "msg", git commit -am "msg"
History: git log, git log --oneline, git log --graph
Branches: git branch, git branch -a, git branch <name>, git checkout <name>, git switch <name>, git checkout -b <name>, git merge <name>, git branch -d/-D <name>
Remote: git remote -v, git remote add origin <URL>, git push origin <branch>, git pull origin <branch>, git fetch origin
Undo: git checkout -- <file>, git reset HEAD <file>, git reset --soft/--hard HEAD~1, git reflog
Other Git: git diff, git stash/pop/list, git tag, git push --tags
pkill command usage
pkill syntax: pkill [options] pattern, options: -9/-KILL, -15/-TERM, -1/-HUP, -f, -u user, -x, -n, -o
pkill examples: pkill firefox, pkill -9 firefox, pkill -HUP nginx, pkill -u username firefox, pkill -f "python app.py"
Verify with pgrep -l firefox before pkill
SSH full name: Secure Shell protocol, history by Tatu Ylönen 1995
Pandoc installation: brew install pandoc, sudo apt install pandoc, download from pandoc.org
